title: UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans
summary: Landing page for UnitedHealthcare Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plans covering plan types, universal benefits, enrollment steps, help numbers and what to do if plans aren't available in a ZIP code.

atoms.title: The Marketplace and ACA plan names
atoms.question: What is the Marketplace and what are ACA plans?
atoms.text: The Marketplace (also called the Exchange) is where ACA health plans are sold. If you buy your own health insurance for you or your family, the Marketplace is for you. You might also hear these plans called Obamacare or Individual & Family plans. UnitedHealthcare says they are all the same thing: affordable health plan options for you and your family.

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare ACA plans offered in 30 states
atoms.question: In how many states does UnitedHealthcare offer ACA Marketplace plans?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare offers Individual & Family plans in 30 states, including Texas, Florida and Georgia. Plan details vary by state, such as premiums, network and certain benefits. The company says some universal benefits are available to everyone no matter where they live.

atoms.title: Preventive services included at no extra cost
atoms.question: What services do UnitedHealthcare ACA plans cover at no additional cost?
atoms.text: With an Individual & Family ACA Marketplace plan you are covered for a variety of services at no additional cost, such as annual checkups, flu shots and other routine vaccines, well child visits, diabetes screenings and more, as recommended by your provider or PCP. If you think you might need a specialist, check whether your plan requires a referral in the UHC app or at myuhc.com/exchange.

atoms.title: Virtual urgent care and pharmacy benefits
atoms.question: What virtual care and prescription benefits come with UnitedHealthcare ACA plans?
atoms.text: Plans include 24/7 virtual urgent care starting as low as zero dollars, letting you see a provider online from wherever you are. Pharmacy benefits start at $10 for a one-month supply of generic medications at network pharmacies like Walgreens or Walmart, and certain medications to help manage cardiac health, mental health, diabetes and other conditions are available for $0 out of pocket.

atoms.title: Digital fitness and gym options with One Pass Select
atoms.question: What fitness perks do UnitedHealthcare ACA plans offer?
atoms.text: For members who want to stay active, ACA plans give access to digital fitness classes through One Pass Select at zero dollars. Members can also choose to get a discounted membership to thousands of popular gyms and even $0 grocery delivery.

atoms.title: Estimating costs and finding network providers
atoms.question: How can I avoid surprise costs on an ACA plan?
atoms.text: To avoid surprise costs, UnitedHealthcare says to find network providers and pharmacies, and to use its cost estimator tool in the UHC app or at myuhc.com/exchange before you get care.

atoms.title: Three steps to begin ACA plan enrollment
atoms.question: How do I start enrolling in a UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace plan?
atoms.text: The enrollment process begins in 3 steps: 1) Enter your ZIP code, then answer a few questions about your family and income. 2) See if you qualify for a subsidy and view recommended plan options. 3) Choose the best plan option for you and UnitedHealthcare will help you enroll. Thinking ahead about current medications, preferred providers and pharmacies can help you find a plan that fits your needs and budget.

atoms.title: Activating ACA coverage after you enroll
atoms.question: What do I need to do after I enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan?
atoms.text: After you enroll in a plan, you'll need to do a few things to activate your coverage: 1) Confirm your eligibility status and plan choice. 2) Send verification documents to the health insurance Marketplace. 3) Make your first premium payment.

atoms.title: If UnitedHealthcare ACA plans aren't in your area
atoms.question: What if UnitedHealthcare ACA plans aren't available where I live?
atoms.text: Your ZIP code and county determine which ACA plans are available. If UnitedHealthcare plans aren't offered in your area, you can call a licensed insurance agent at 1-877-732-0569 or go to HealthMarkets to see ACA plans from other companies. In New York, ACA plans from other companies may be available through New York State of Health, and in Massachusetts through the Massachusetts Health Connector.

atoms.title: Help lines for shoppers and members
atoms.question: What phone numbers can I call about UnitedHealthcare ACA plans?
atoms.text: Shoppers can talk with a licensed insurance agent at 1-800-557-6718, TTY 711, from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET Monday through Friday and 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET Saturday; the line is closed Sunday. Existing members can call Member Services at 1-877-265-9199, TTY 711, which offers 24/7 Member Services plus Care Support, or sign in to the member site.
